blocking_condition: Real-model collection is not part of this repair run. A fixed execution adapter/model, natural candidates, independent future tasks, and metered costs must be configured before empirical claims.
decision_object: One frozen modification relative to one fixed baseline.
application_rule: Apply an accepted modification unchanged on each held-out task; apply baseline after rejection. No retrieval, library insertion, combination, or best-of-N selection.
primary_scope: Binary adoption under fixed false-accept/false-reject costs of 1/1; no claim of dollar-denominated net benefit.
utility_definition: Task success under the same predeclared execution limits, bounded in [0,1].
reference_uncertainty: Use independent paired held-out tasks. Effects not separated from the threshold by the declared uncertainty rule stay unresolved. The provided Hoeffding bound presumes independent bounded task differences; it is not valid merely because task IDs differ.

groups.A: Initial complete baseline/candidate validation evidence only.
groups.B: The same initial evidence plus additional complete validation of the unchanged task.
groups.C: The same initial evidence plus identifier-renaming diagnostic evidence.

diagnostic.name: bijective_opaque_identifier_renaming
diagnostic.domain: A structured DAG tool task whose identifiers are explicitly opaque.
diagnostic.validity: Nonidentity total bijection; inverse mapping strictly recovers parsed JSON types and values except administrative task id. Boolean, integer, and float types are distinct; dictionary key order is immaterial and array order is preserved.
diagnostic.restriction: This is a controlled task transformation, not a generic proof that arbitrary filenames, code identifiers, or human-readable names are irrelevant. It changes the evidence protocol relative to current-task-only Harness2.
diagnostic.candidate_set: Frozen. The probe does not generate an adoptable replacement patch.

budget.unit: USD when actually metered; otherwise unknown.
budget.evaluation_only_cost: Held-out runs are accounted separately and never exposed as selection evidence.
budget.unknown_cost_policy: Null remains unknown; never substitute zero or certify equal dollar expenditure.
budget.overrun_policy: Do not cherry-pick precomputed outcomes using their realized costs. Flag budget violations and incomplete allocation evidence.

paired_event_cost_scope.execution_only: When both execution components are known, total must equal their sum within tolerance. Otherwise it must cover all known components.
paired_event_cost_scope.execution_plus_overhead: Total includes both executions and extra costs of this event; every known execution component must be covered.
paired_event_cost_scope.partial_information: Null totals are never reconstructed and null/missing components are never zero-filled. A directly reported complete total may have an unknown allocation; audit marks partial or unchecked relationships.
paired_event_cost_scope.single_charge: Count event total once; neither re-add component amounts nor duplicate already included overhead in separate events.
paired_event_cost_scope.rejection: Contradictory amounts fail input validation before all judge calls and output creation.

judge.training_policy: None in the demo. A real trained judge must use identical training procedures and task-family-disjoint development data in all groups; account for its calibration cost.
judge.limits: A child-process request whitelist is evidence hygiene, not an OS security boundary. A real model runner must not receive filesystem access to held-out outcomes.

splits: Separate development/calibration/test by task family or repository, never by repeated trajectory from the same task.
candidate_collection: Use all eligible modifications from a fixed generator. Do not retain only the hypothesized failure types. Record generation failures and eligibility exclusions.
primary_comparison: C versus repeated validation on the same original task (B), at the same additional budget cap, with realized spend and missingness reported. This does not compare against equally costly new-task validation.
stop_rule_for_research: If C does not improve adoption outcomes over B on naturally generated held-out modifications after accounting for costs and uncertainty, do not build a more elaborate scheduler yet.
nonclaims: Synthetic examples do not establish the prevalence of real candidate failure modes.
A plumbing test does not establish C > B.
The fixed-cost binary decision objective is not a complete risk-sensitive or monetary utility objective.
No real candidates, model trajectories, dollar costs, or empirical agent improvements have been collected in this environment.
C beating B would support ID-renaming evidence versus repeated-original-task evidence, not superiority to new-task validation.
Hash-verified supplied artifacts do not attest actual execution or statistical independence.
A complete-case paired comparison can still select easier units; missing judgments are not correct decisions.

input_contract.frozen_artifacts: Verify embedded baseline, candidate, and replace_text patch UTF-8 contents and SHA-256; bind patch to its baseline and every event/run to the same frozen artifacts.
input_contract.task_provenance: Verify original and renamed task content hashes, root source_id, explicit mapping, and same-variant baseline/candidate runs.
input_contract.execution_records: Paired execution is mandatory. Explicit failed/not_run sides have an error and no fabricated utility. Cost-only records cannot impersonate paired runs.
input_contract.failed_probe: Explicit generation/validity failure may occur before any pair; retain its cost and mark diagnostic_complete false. Do not silently drop the unit.
input_contract.heldout: Check explicit overlap of task IDs, content hashes and root source_ids with visible evidence; disallow repeated root source_id within one unit.
input_contract.legacy: Real v1 input is rejected; no automatic fabrication or version-only relabeling.
input_contract.limits: Internal consistency, not proof of actual execution, opaque-ID semantics, complete collection, or statistical independence.

aggregation.conditional_group_means: Explicit names and denominators; never compare conditional group means from different unit sets.
aggregation.paired_loss: Only the same units with completed B/C decisions and resolved references.
aggregation.paired_descriptive_gain: Only the same units with completed B/C decisions and observed heldout gains; unresolved labels need not exclude descriptive gains.
aggregation.missingness: List exclusions and reasons; any incomplete B/C judgment pairing is INCOMPLETE_PAIRING and supports no overall superiority conclusion.
aggregation.loss_bounds: Across every resolved-reference unit, fix observed losses and range each missing loss over [0,1]. Report algebraic bounds, not confidence intervals.
aggregation.superiority: No inferential superiority test is implemented; even all-complete comparisons remain descriptive.

sample_planning.note: A conditional threshold-crossing calculation under the unchanged default Hoeffding rule, not prospective statistical power or guaranteed detection.
sample_planning.precommitment: Freeze thresholds, sample size, and sampling before evaluation; do not relax thresholds or apply a fixed-sample interval after uncontrolled optional stopping.
